title: The home hero images preload and use responsive formats
detail: Hero LCP images are CSS background-image (kit-site.css:34, site-pages-a.css:15-16), undiscovered until CSS parses, no AVIF or srcset. Expected 150-400 ms LCP on mobile. Also move the 20 raw img tags in components/frequency/site to sized next/image.
